title: PatchSet
description: An ordered list of targeted edits across one or more existing resources (panel/dashboard/dataSource/dataType/pipeline/pipelineStep), produced by conversational refinement so a diff can be previewed and applied atomically. Carries NO create/apply semantics of its own — this schema/protocol is the foundation only; a future apply path (HEL-406 and siblings) consumes it. Mirrors schemas/pipeline-proposal.schema.json's scope (schema+protocol only, no apply route in this ticket).

summary.description: Optional human-readable description of the whole patch set (e.g. an agent's one-line summary of the refinement).

edits.description: Ordered list of targeted edits, applied in array order by a future apply path.

Edit.description: One targeted edit against a single resource. `patch`'s real shape reuses the existing per-resource PATCH/create request shapes rather than inventing new ones, documented here by name (none of the six has its own standalone schema file to $ref against): for op=update, the existing UpdatePanelRequest/UpdateDashboardRequest/UpdateDataSourceRequest/UpdateDataTypeRequest/UpdatePipelineRequest/UpdatePipelineStepRequest shape matching target.kind (the same type the matching PATCH endpoint already decodes); for op=create, the matching CreatePanelRequest/CreateDashboardRequest/CreateDataSourceRequest/CreateDataTypeRequest/CreatePipelineRequest/CreatePipelineStepRequest shape, decoded by a future apply path (HEL-406), not this contract; for op=delete, `patch` is unused.

patch.description: Partial update body, real shape selected by (target.kind, op) — see this schema's own description above. Absent for delete edits.

EditTarget.description: Identifies the resource an Edit applies to. `id` is required for update/delete (enforced by Edit's own if/then) and optional for create, where the resource does not yet exist.
